entities.name: main street (inside the gate, through the crossroads)
entities.what: The town's main east-west street, continuing S5's road west from the wine depot: past the front of 孙羊正店 (its 彩楼欢门, lamp-boxes and slatted railings; sedans and riders in the street), the butcher's shop and the corner shop with the storyteller's crowd, across the mouth of the cross street at the crossroads, past the incense shop and the paper-horse stall to the square well on its north margin. On the north side the open ground stops at the shop fronts; on the south side at the roofs of the houses along the silk's bottom edge (the inn 久住王员外家 and its neighbours), except between the 解 building (u ~2050-2165) and the inn's west wing (u ~3160), where it opens into a wide square that runs out over the silk's bottom edge.
entities.vis: part: north margin behind crowds and stalls; south margin behind the south-side roofs
entities.note: No road edge is drawn as a line; edges are where the open ground stops. edge_n: the wall foot of the house behind the well (v ~800; the well stands on the street's north margin), the incense shop's south end (est v 790, behind the paper-horse stall's parasols, whose feet are at v ~850), its south-east corner (est 2908,790), then straight across the mouth of the cross street to the corner shop's south-west corner (est 3725,865), the corner shop, butcher's and 正店 fronts (column feet hidden by the crowd: est v 872, 880-885, 905; a gap of ~100 px between the butcher's and the 正店 at 4340-4441 holds only the slanting flag pole), and the wine depot's floor front (S5, est v 885-888). The 正店's slatted railings stand on the street ~95 px in front of its front (feet v ~1000). edge_s: the 解 building's north side and its slanted east board ((2045,1310) down to the silk's edge at (2165,1775); the building is S7's); open ground to the silk's edge (measured at v 1772-1785 along the section) from u ~2165 to the inn's west wing; the wing's west wall (est, along the receding direction from (3161,1775) to its NW corner (3501,1440)); then the north walls of the south-side houses, all hidden behind their own roofs, est at v 1440 to meet S5 (5600,1440). Nothing painted on the street stands lower than v ~1440 east of the wing (the boy at 3420,1395; trestles and a rider at 4800-5300, feet 1420-1440), so 1440 is the street's narrowest reading; the houses' real north walls may lie up to ~150 px lower (S5's house_5800 has porch posts with feet at v 1694-1758 under a top line at 1450): a question for the lead. Centre: through the traffic between the edges (walkers and porters at v 1100-1250 west of the crossroads; east of it midway between the fronts and v 1440, easing to S5's road end); its last point is exactly (5600,1250). The cross street S6.road.cross_2970 leaves it northward between u 2908 and 3725 (north edge).

entities.name: cross street at the crossroads (running north)
entities.what: The street that leaves the main street northward at the crossroads, between the incense shop's open east front (its west side) and the corner shop's long west side (its east side); two four-mule wagons swing round the corner on it and a porter with baskets crosses it. It runs straight back up the silk and ends at the top street, in front of the cloth shop and the 杨家 clinic.
entities.vis: part: its east side's foot hidden behind the corner shop's roof
entities.note: Both sides are receding lines (the incense shop's east eave, slope -1.04, and the corner shop's west eave and ridge, -0.91 / -1.14), so it runs due north. Its walls' feet are hidden: edge_w = the incense shop's east wall (est 240 px below its east eave, the eave height measured on the corner shop's front); edge_e = the corner shop's west wall (est 265 px below its west eave). About 11.5 m wide (820 px of u at the mouth). The centre starts on the main street's centre line (2970,1178) and is drawn along the receding direction (dx ~52). It meets the main street's north edge between (2908,790) and (3725,865). South of the main street there is no built edge: the ground between the 解 building and the inn's west wing is an open square running out over the silk's edge, so the street may continue south across it, but nothing marks it. North: it ends at the top street (S6.road.top_2814), across which the cloth shop and the clinic front it (their post feet v 180-197); it leaves the silk only through that street. Tables and a lattice cabinet under the incense shop's lean-to stand on its west margin (3200-3330).

entities.name: top street (behind the incense shop, in front of the cloth shop)
entities.what: An east-west street at the very top of the silk, where the cross street ends: people and a handcart with a mule behind the incense shop's north gable, and the cloth shop and the 杨家 clinic fronting it on its north side; its west part runs behind the incense compound and out of the silk at the top-left.
entities.vis: part: mostly behind the compound and corner shop roofs; north margin cut by the silk
entities.note: Ground is seen at (3050-3250, v 80-165) behind the incense shop's north gable (two men at a bench or rail, a man with a load) and around the cart at 3260-3420, v 30-160. edge_n: the cloth shop's and clinic's post feet (v 180-197); west of the cloth shop's west end the ground reaches higher (v ~80) and the silk's top edge. edge_s: the north range of the incense compound (est v 286), the incense shop's north gable (est 3245,440), across the cross street's mouth, the corner shop's north end (est). Its east end is hidden behind the corner shop's roof and the big tree at 4150-4500; its course beyond is unknown.

entities.name: square well (方井) with its 田-shaped cover
entities.what: The square well on the street's north margin at the west end of the section: a low wooden curb with a 田-shaped plank cover (a cross of bars dividing the opening into four, water strokes in the openings), set in the middle of a wide plank platform whose boards run east-west; men draw water at it with ropes, and tall hooped wooden buckets stand on the platform's west end.
entities.vis: part: west end of the platform behind the buckets
entities.src: 名画记 47 方井 (2110); 余辉: 深井汲水
entities.note: Base = the curb/cover. Curb front edge v ~955 (2000-2175), back edge v ~880 (2030-2205); cross bars at v ~915 and u ~2100-2110. PLATFORM (part of this structure, around the curb): back edge v ~855 from ~1995 (behind the buckets) to 2282; front edge v ~997 from ~1955 to 2240; east side (2240,998)->(2282,858). Its boards show 6-8 px of thickness at the front and the curb stands ~10-15 px proud of them: both low, well under knee height. SEAM: the curb's centre is (2102,917) and the platform's (2118,927), east of u 2000, so the well is S6's; only the platform's west end (u ~1955-2000) lies on the S7 side. SCALE CUES (px): curb 175 wide at the front, 75 deep in v; platform ~285 wide, ~140 deep in v; buckets 45-55 wide, 55-65 tall; the men at the well ~100-110 tall. DEPTH DIRECTION: platform east side (2240,998)->(2282,858) (slope -3.3) and curb east side (2175,955)->(2205,880) (slope -2.5) are far steeper than every building edge (-0.8 to -1.15): the well is drawn almost from above; use them with low weight or not at all.

entities.name: 彩楼欢门 (flowered scaffold gateway) of 孙羊正店
entities.what: The flowered scaffold gateway across the whole front of 孙羊正店: lashed poles (the west corner pole round and bound with rope lashings) rise from the street front past the ground-floor eave to the upper storey's eave, their tops tied with flower bunches, sprays and streamers; between them a lattice of cross-bars and diagonal braces forms a broad shallow V across the middle, hung with flowers and red streamers, and on its east side parallel bars run back toward the building. Lanterns: round 栀子灯 with cross-pattern frames on posts at the doors and one high in the middle, and a cube lantern above the 正店 box. At its feet stand the lamp-boxes 正店, 孫□ and 香□ (see note).
entities.vis: part: pole feet hidden by the crowd; its upper part in front of the upper storey
entities.src: 名画记 36 孙羊家正店 (4530), 38 栀子灯 (5060); sections.md: 彩楼欢门, lamp-boxes 正店 / 孙□ / 香醪
entities.note: Read from the scroll's strokes only (the AI restyle turns it into a second tier of balconies). West pole 4432-4450, seen from v ~380 down to ~880 with lashings at v 735-760 (it doubles as the 正店's west column); flower-topped poles at 4460, 4495, 4530 rise to v 170-200; others at ~4880-4900 and ~4990-5010; the east-most tall pole at 5292-5302 with a pointed, flagged top at v ~170; a slender post at 5340-5355 (v 680-900). Main horizontals: a top beam at v ~430-450 (4440-5300, just under the upper balustrade) and a lower beam at v ~700-710 (along the ground-floor eave). V-braces: (4600,600) down to (4800,690) and (5170,600) down to (4980,690). Lanterns: round at (4655,735) and (5105,745), each on a post (4645-4660 and 5075-5085, v ~760-900), round at (4845,655) on the scaffold, cube at (4525,725). Lamp-boxes (box with a small cap, standing on the ground at the doors: tile agents' props): 正店 4482-4553, v 790-900 (both characters clear); 孫□ 4650-4695, v 795-880 (孫 clear, the second hidden by heads; 羊 per sections.md); 香□ 5130-5195, v 790-900 (香 clear, the second hidden by a headdress; 醪 per sections.md). Base: a strip ~0.6 m deep on the 正店's column line (est, feet hidden). DEPTH DIRECTION: the parallel bars on its east side, (5272,488)->(5432,340) (slope -0.93) and (5300,690)->(5455,520) (slope -1.10), run back toward the building (its east face, or the upper storey's east side; checked on an overlay). SCALE CUES (px): poles ~12-18 thick; overall height ~730 (915 -> 175-190, about 9.4 m at 77 px/m); lamp-box 正店 71 wide x 110 tall; round lanterns ~45-55 across.

entities.name: slatted railing in front of the 正店 west door
entities.what: Low barrier fence of close-set vertical slats under a top rail, standing on the street in front of 孙羊正店's west door, just below the 正店 lamp-box; a gap (the way in) separates it from the next stretch at 4610.
entities.vis: part: a seated man in front of its west half
entities.note: Slats 4412-4565 from the top rail (v ~885-890; a second rail at ~905) down to v ~1000-1003. SCALE CUES: ~115 px tall; slats ~6-8 px apart. Gap 4565-4610 (a man stands in it). Stands ~1.9 m in front of the 正店's column line (est v 905).

entities.name: slatted railing in front of 孙羊正店 (middle)

entities.vis: part: heads of the crowd in front

entities.name: slatted railing in front of 孙羊正店 (east, by the 香□ box)

entities.vis: part: only its top (v 870-905) shows above the animals and people

entities.name: low fence among the bamboo (top left)
entities.what: Low fence of horizontal boards among the bamboo groves at the top-left of the section, in front of the far house S6.bld.far_house_1859.
entities.vis: part: among bamboo leaves
entities.note: Horizontal strokes 2000-2120, v 180-240, with a small round object at (2110,195). Could be the top of a low shed instead.

entities.name: far house above the bamboo (top left)
entities.what: Long tiled house at the very top-left of the silk, behind the bamboo groves: its roof (diagonal tile rows) cut by the silk's top edge, an eave at v ~100, and small gable ends with ornaments at both ends (u ~1825 and ~2330); walls hidden by the bamboo.
entities.vis: part: roof only; cut by the silk top; front behind bamboo
entities.note: Roof tiles v 0-100 from ~1820 to 2330; end ornaments/gables at 1820-1830 (v 40-100) and 2320-2340 (v 40-110). Front est just behind the bamboo and the low fence (v ~227), 3 m deep, shifted by the receding direction (so its corners sit east of the painted roof ends). SEAM: it straddles S7 (west end at u ~1825, main point at u 1859); most of it is in S6.

entities.name: house behind the square well
entities.what: Single-storey house behind the square well: a tiled roof (vertical tile rows; ridge hidden by willow crowns) with round tile-ends along its eave, over a plain blank wall facing the street; the men at the well stand in front of its foot. Its roof runs on east behind the big willow's trunk.
entities.vis: part: roof top behind willow branches; wall foot behind the men at the well
entities.note: Eave v 665-672 with tile-end discs from 2020 to 2250 and the same roof seen through the willow at 2270-2450, v 530-670; blank wall 2020-2250, v 672-800; a horizontal line at v ~795-800 (1915-2240) read as its wall foot (or the top of a low yard wall in front). East end est at u 2310, where the incense shop's south end begins. A pole stands at its east end (2245-2255, v 650-900: a prop if free-standing). West of 2000 a small dark sloping roof (1880-1960, v 735-805) belongs to S7. Back est 2.5 m deep. SCALE CUES: eave ~130 px above the foot (1.3 x the well men's ~100 px). DEPTH DIRECTION: none drawn.

entities.name: west range of the incense compound
entities.what: West range of a compound under one U-shaped tiled roof (with S6.bld.north_range_2283 and the incense shop): its ridge runs back (north) from behind the big willows to the ridge ornament at the north-west corner, where it turns east into the north range's ridge; tiles on both slopes, walls hidden by the willows.
entities.vis: part: roof only; south part behind willow crowns
entities.note: Ridge (2190,310)->(2462,55), the corner ornament at (2462,55): DEPTH DIRECTION, slope -0.94 (dx ~54.7). From the ornament a valley line runs down-right to the inner eave corner (2660,195) between this range's east slope and the north range's south slope. West slope tiles 2120-2330, v 230-450. Base est in ground metres: ridge ~5.1 m up (as the incense shop's), so the ridge lies over X ~-89.8; 5 m wide; north end at the incense shop's north gable line; south end just behind the house behind the well. Facing assumed east (toward the light-well between the ranges).

entities.name: north range of the incense compound (top of the silk)
entities.what: North range of the U-shaped compound: a tiled roof whose ridge runs east-west between the ridge ornaments at the compound's two back corners, its south slope of vertical tile rows seen between the west range and the incense shop, ending in a small inner eave corner over a narrow light-well.
entities.vis: part: roof only; front slope partly behind the ranges' roofs
entities.note: Ridge (2470,55)->(2940,48), level; south-slope tile rows end at v ~190-200 (2560-2800), inner eave corner ornament at (2660,190). Base est: placed behind (north of) both ranges' north ends so footprints do not overlap; the drawn ridge then stands over its south wall line (the ranges are one connected roof and only its ridges are drawn, so the split is a choice). The ridge's east end (2940,48) is straight above se, 5.1 m up. Above the ridge, at the silk's top (2560-2720, v 0-50), more structure: S6.bld.far_building_2561.

entities.name: building beyond the compound (top edge)
entities.what: Fragment of a building at the silk's top edge beyond the compound's north range: diagonal timbers, a small pale gable and a tiny signboard with two or three illegible characters (□□).
entities.vis: part: only a strip at the silk's top edge
entities.note: Strokes at 2560-2720, v 0-50: diagonal members (2560,50)->(2620,0) and parallels, a pale triangle (gable) at 2680-2720, v 10-50, a small board with characters at 2585-2620, v 5-35. Base est on the top street's north side (feet hidden behind the north range). Could also be a stall.

entities.name: 刘家 incense shop (香药铺)
entities.what: The 刘家 incense and perfume shop, the east range of the U-shaped compound: a long tiled hall running back (north) along the west side of the cross street, its ridge receding to a gabled north end with a ridge ornament; its east eave carries a lattice fascia board with two or three illegible characters near its south end. Under a dark matted lean-to roof along its east side the open shop front faces the cross street, with long tables and a lattice cabinet; the tall vertical signboard 劉家上色沉檀揀□ (last character hidden behind a hat; 香 by scholarship) stands at its south-east front corner. A row of tall poles hung with small goods stands along its east eave.
entities.vis: part: south end behind the pale awning and willows; west slope behind willows
entities.src: 名画记 41 香药铺 (3200); sections.md: 刘家上色沉檀拣香
entities.note: Ridge (2660,335)->(2940,48), slope -1.025 (dx ~50.0); east eave (2870,590)->(3245,200), slope -1.04 (dx ~49.3): both DEPTH DIRECTION. North gable verge from the ridge end (2940,48) down to the NE eave corner (3245,200): the east half-width is 305/77 = 4.0 m and the ridge 2.0 m above the eave. Base est: wall feet 240 px below the eave (the corner shop's front shows 265, the 正店 ground floor ~195), so SE (2908,790) and NE (3245,440); west wall 3.5 m west of the ridge. Its south end is hidden (the paper-horse stall's parasols and a pale cloth awning stand in front of it). Lean-to: dark roof from the east eave out to ~(3330,330), over tables at 3200-3330, v 360-560 and a lattice cabinet at 3240-3330, v 290-370 (props). SIGN 3133-3170, v 345-565: 劉 家 上 色 沉 檀 揀 legible, the eighth character behind a hat; its foot (~3150,570) is just east of the est wall line, so it may stand on its own post (tile agents' prop). Fascia inscription at ~2945-2990, v 540-590 (illegible). Tall poles with hanging goods at 2900-3150, v 200-560 (props). SCALE CUES (px): sign 37 x 220; table rows ~80-100 long, legs ~50; fascia band ~25.

entities.name: 王家 cloth shop (匹帛铺)
entities.what: Long open-fronted shop at the top of the silk facing south onto the top street, where the cross street ends: a dark, densely tiled roof cut by the silk's top edge, six small square plaques with one character each hung along its eave (illegible: □□□□□□), posts on bases and long counters under the eave. At its west end stands its tall signboard (王家羅明匹帛鋪 per sections.md; legible □錦疋帛 with 鋪 in a separate lower box) on a stand of its own.
entities.vis: part: roof cut by the silk top; front partly behind the counters
entities.note: A dark eave fascia band from the silk's top down to v ~95-100 (3450-3850) (sw_eave/se_eave = its lower edge); the plaques, ~20 px square at v 48-78, hang on it, centred at u ~3488, 3550, 3612, 3680, 3745, 3810 (not readable at this resolution); posts 3505-3515 (foot 3510,183) and 3700-3710 (foot ~188); counters 3540-3640 (v 105-160) and 3640-3740 (v 100-170); its east end meets the clinic at ~3850. Back corners est (3 m deep), roof top beyond the silk. SIGN on its own stand (a tile agents' prop): board 3415-3475, v 0-120 (first visible character cut by the silk edge, then one read as 錦 (unclear; sections.md has 明), 疋, 帛), lower box 3430-3470, v 85-120 (鋪), frame and feet to v ~150. SCALE CUES (px): posts ~88 tall from the fascia's lower edge to their feet, ~10 thick, 195 apart; plaques 20; the man at the clinic next door stands ~100 tall, taller than these posts: the buildings at the top of the silk are drawn small (front-street eaves stand 195-285 above their feet). DEPTH DIRECTION: none drawn.

entities.name: 杨家 clinic (杨家应症)
entities.what: Shop at the top of the silk east of the cloth shop, facing south onto the top street: tiled roof cut by the silk's top edge, a pale frieze board under the eave, an open front with a counter on the west side and a man standing at the front; the tall vertical signboard 楊家應症 hangs on its east corner post.
entities.vis: part: roof cut by the silk top; east part behind the corner shop's roof
entities.src: sections.md: 杨家应症 / 杨大夫经诊 clinic
entities.note: Eave v ~40-45 (3850-4090); frieze v 45-80, lintel ~95-100 (3900-4000); posts 3900 (v 60-175) and the east corner post 4100-4110 (v 0-~200) carrying the SIGN 4100-4145, v 0-140: 楊 家 應 症, all four clear. 杨大夫经诊 (sections.md) is not seen on the scan. The man at its front (4010-4050) stands ~100 px tall. Back corners est (3 m deep). DEPTH DIRECTION: none drawn.

entities.name: corner shop at the crossroads (storyteller in front)
entities.what: Shop on the north-east corner of the crossroads, where the storyteller holds his crowd: a long hall running back (north) along the east side of the cross street under a hip-gable (歇山) roof, its small gable facing the main street above a front roof whose south-west corner turns up, beast ornaments on the hips and a lattice frieze under the eave; open front on posts with a counter inside; a small signboard with three or four illegible characters (□□□□) hangs under the eave by its west post. Its long west eave runs back up the cross street almost to the top of the silk.
entities.vis: part: front feet behind the seated listeners; east side behind the butcher shop roof
entities.src: 名画记 39 闹市说书 (3840), 40 城里的商铺 (3920)
entities.note: Front eave v ~600 (3730-4065) with a lattice frieze 600-650; SW eave corner turned up at (3720,548), hip ornaments at (3800,515) and (3880,465); small south gable 3940-4020, v 450-530, apex (3990,445). DEPTH DIRECTION: ridge (3990,445)->(4235,165), slope -1.14 (dx ~44.8); west eave upper part (4060,240)->(4280,40), slope -0.91 (dx ~56.4) (its lower part (3720,548)->(3890,440) bends with the hip skirt: not used). Posts 3760-3775 (v 650 to ~860), ~3870 (v 650-760), a tall dark post 4065-4090 (v 500-870) at its east end (or the butcher's west post). Counter top v 720-745 (3780-4000). Base: front feet est v ~865-872 (hidden by the listeners); NW foot = the west eave's north end (4280,40) + 265 px (the front's eave height) = (4280,305): ~10.9 m deep; NE by the same shift (the east side is hidden; the butcher's roof may be this hall's east lean-to). SCALE CUES (px): eave 265 above the front feet; posts ~15 wide; counter ~220 long; listeners 110-140 tall. MERGE: its counter (3780-4000) is the 孫羊店 meat counter of the tile maps (S6.prop.meat_counter_3856 with the chopping block, hanging pork and the butcher), and the storyteller stands just in front of it; the 孫羊店 flag hangs before the next building east (S6.bld.butcher_shop_sun), which may be this shop's east lean-to.

entities.name: 孙羊店 butcher's shop
entities.what: Butcher's shop of 孙羊店 east of the corner shop: a tiled front roof (vertical tile rows) under a straight ridge, a lattice frieze and a dark valance under the eave, a pale wall panel at its west end and an open front hung with pale cloth panels; the long white flag 孫羊店 hangs in front of it from a pole slanting across its front, and a big parasol shades the street before it (the flag's pole and the parasol are tile agents' props).
entities.vis: part: front feet behind the parasol and the crowd
entities.src: sections.md: the 孙羊店 butcher's flag (≈4100)
entities.note: Ridge v ~425 (4085-4335); eave v 590-600 (4100-4330); frieze 600-640, valance 640-700 (4200-4330); pale wall 4100-4180, v 560-850. FLAG 4130-4205, v 590-720: 孫 羊 店, clear, hung from a pole running straight from (4085,545) at this roof's west end down to (4445,835) at the 正店's west column (where its foot probably stands). Front feet est v ~880 behind the parasol (4190-4400, v 740-860). Back est 3 m deep; it may instead be the corner shop's east lean-to (its ridge starts where the corner shop's east slope ends). Between it and the 正店 (4340-4440) only slanting members and the flag pole show (an alley?). SCALE CUES: eave ~285 above the est feet; flag 75 x 130. The two may be one shop (孙羊店), this its east lean-to (as the structures pass suspected); the name is kept.

entities.name: 孙羊正店 (the 孙羊 licensed wine house)
entities.what: 孙羊正店, the big licensed wine house, two storeys. Ground floor: an open street front on round columns under a long tiled lean-to roof, with doors behind the 正店 and 香□ lamp-boxes, drinkers at tables, wine jars and two big bottle-shaped decorations at the doors; its whole front is masked by the 彩楼欢门 and fenced by low slatted railings. Upper storey (the drinking floor), behind a balustrade: lattice windows and open bays with drinkers at tables, under a big hip-gable roof with a heavy rolled ridge, a curled ornament and a small gable at its east end, and upturned eave corners at both ends; the upper storey runs east past the ground floor, behind the wine depot (S5), to u ~5700.
entities.vis: part: ground floor behind the 彩楼 and the crowd; feet hidden
entities.src: 名画记 36 孙羊家正店 (4530), 37 正店门前 (5590); 余辉: 正店开张
entities.note: UPPER FLOOR: floor line (balustrade foot; rail top v ~420) at v ~442 over u 4440-5650; the street front below it (column feet, est) is at v ~905, and the ground straight below the balustrade is hidden. Readings: if the balustrade stood straight above the street front the floor would be 6.0 m up; the upper storey's west end (lattice from 4560, balustrade from 4440) lines up with the ground floor's west column (4441) for a set-back of ~0-2.2 m (ground v ~905-792, floor 6.0-4.5 m); a 4 m set-back (ground v ~700) gives 3.4 m. The ground-floor roof shows only ~110 px (eave 705 -> ~600) before the 彩楼's V-band, which also argues for a small set-back. Upper front: lattice windows 4570-4800 and 4900-5300 (v 255-420), open east bays 5300-5650 with a drinker at (5515,360-420), lattice window 5580-5640, east post 5700-5710. Upper eave (tile-end discs) v ~250 (4560-4800), ~275 (4880-5180), ~285-290 (5290-5650), turned up to ~(5700,250); rolled ridge v ~40-55 from ~4650 to the east ornament (5630,30); east gable 5600-5660, v 40-200, with a lower skirt roof 5580-5770, v 160-260; west end a hip from (4650,25) down to the turned-up corner (4515,175). Ground floor: eave v 705-712 (4440-5350), its roof rising to v ~600; columns (feet hidden, est v 905): 4441 (round, lashed: also the 彩楼's west pole), 4555-4570 and 4590-4600 (door posts by the 正店 box), 4760-4775, 4800-4815, 5265-5290 (round, capital at v 785-800), 5340-5355; its east end meets the wine depot's west post (5395-5410). Bottle-shaped decorations 4400-4440 and 5030-5070, v 770-880 (props). Base: front est v 905; back est 8.5 m deep (dx ~54), to the S5 back hall's front. DEPTH DIRECTION: the parallel members on the east side (see the 彩楼): (5272,488)->(5432,340), slope -0.93 (dx ~55.4), and (5300,690)->(5455,520), slope -1.10 (dx ~46.7). SCALE CUES (px): ground-floor eave ~195 above the est feet; columns 15-20 thick; bays 35-120 (4441-4562 = 121, door 4562-4595, 4808-5277 has no visible column); upper lattice windows ~70 x 140; balustrade ~22 tall; drinkers upstairs ~60-70 (half hidden). COMPLEX: with S6.str.cailou_huanmen_4430, the railings S6.str.railing_*, and probably S5.bld.back_hall_5790 (it abuts the upper storey's east end at u ~5700) with the railed stair at its west end. MERGE (from t5): also painted on its ground-floor front, as parts of this building: a dark cloth banner hung at u 4971-5006, v 756-804, and a shop counter inside at u 4730-4810, v 805-840.

entities.name: west wing of the inn 久住王员外家
entities.what: West wing of the inn, seen from behind (its street front faces north): a lower tiled roof whose ridge runs east-west with a curled ornament at its west end and a small hip-gable (歇山) gable rising above it; walls hidden. The inn's signboard 久住王員外家 (a top cell with 久住 in two small characters, then 王 員 外 家) stands just west of it, its foot hidden by the willows.
entities.vis: part: roof only; south part behind willows and cut by the silk edge
entities.src: 名画记 42 久住王员外家 (3310)
entities.note: Ridge v ~1420 (3335-3688), west ornament (3324,1410), which lies straight above the middle of its est west wall; small gable 3430-3476, apex ornament (3453,1384); tiles down to an eave at v ~1530-1560. SIGN 3245-3300, v 1298-1505 (all six characters clear); it may stand on its own post (tile agents' prop); in ground terms it stands ~1.8 m west of this wing. A boy stands on the street just above its ridge (feet ~3420,1395). Base est in ground metres: north wall at the street's south edge (v 1440), south wall at the silk's edge (v 1790, the eave ~245 px above it), the inn's west wall as its east side; corners shifted by the receding direction (dx ~52). DEPTH DIRECTION: none reliable (the roof's lower edge (3465,1546)->(3612,1493), slope -0.36, is a curved eave).

entities.name: inn 久住王员外家 (main hall, two storeys)
entities.what: 久住王员外家, the inn: a two-storey hall on the south side of the street, seen from behind (south). A big hip-gable (歇山) roof with its west gable (king post and hanging-fish board 懸魚) turned to the viewer and its ridge running east to an upturned end; on the upper storey's south face, under a deep eave and frieze, a slatted window, the open bay where a scholar sits reading at a desk (士子苦读), a second open bay with a figure among books, and a little railed balcony at the east end; below, the ground floor's own roof with a small gable, cut by the silk's edge.
entities.vis: part: ground floor cut by the silk's edge; street front hidden behind its roof
entities.src: 名画记 42 久住王员外家 (3310), 44 赶考士人 (3240); 余辉: 士子苦读
entities.note: UPPER FLOOR: floor line (window sill, bottom of the window band) at v ~1705 over u 3690-4280, on the south face; the ground straight below it is beyond the silk's edge (the lower roof is cut by the silk at v ~1775, ~70 px below the sill), so the floor height cannot be measured here. Base est: south wall foot at v ~1965, i.e. the sill 3.4 m up as one reading of the 正店's floor (state this as an assumption); north wall at the street's south edge (v 1440): ~10.2 m deep, corners shifted by the receding direction (dx ~52). Check: the west gable apex (3810,1288) then lies straight above the middle of the west wall (ground u 3812), as a gable should. Roof: west gable apex (3810,1288), verges to (3600,1490) and (3930,1420); ridge from the apex east to ~(4300,1395), its east end turned up at (4330,1425); south eave (3950-4300) at v ~1560-1590. Upper storey band (frieze) v 1555-1600 (3570-4300); windows v 1600-1705: slatted 3690-3770, the scholar's bay 3860-3960 (the scholar seated, head at ~1650), second bay 4020-4100, balcony rail 4100-4200 at v ~1590. Lower roof with its own gable apex (3830,1680), 3680-4000, cut by the silk. DEPTH DIRECTION: none usable (the gable verge (3600,1490)->(3810,1288), slope -0.96, rises toward the apex and mixes depth and height). SCALE CUES (px): scholar's head and shoulders ~55 above the sill; slatted window ~80 x 100; frieze to sill ~145. Goes with S6.bld.inn_west_wing_3146.

entities.name: south-side houses east of the inn (roofs running back)
entities.what: Tiled roofs between the inn's east end and the willows along the bottom edge: a roof whose west eave runs diagonally back (north) up the silk from the silk's edge, a low roof at the silk's edge, and a roof edge under the willows; walls hidden. Possibly two or three small houses, recorded as one.
entities.vis: part: roofs only, cut by the silk edge and the willows
entities.note: West eave running back: (4134,1784)->(4346,1609), slope -0.83 (dx ~62.1): DEPTH DIRECTION (med conf, checked on an overlay), with parallel tile rows above it (4184,1740)->(4352,1578); with a ~3 m eave its line lies along the inn's east wall, so this roof starts there. A low roof 4180-4370, v 1680-1775; a roof edge 4430-4520, v 1650-1775; south-slope tiles 4720-4830, v 1550-1700 (eave ~1645) under the willows. The small roof end with vertical tile rows at 4340-4420, v 1400-1470 near the street is more likely the inn's north-east part. Base est in ground metres: the inn's depth (v 1965 -> 1440), ~3.6 m wide, between the inn and S6.bld.house_south_4839.

entities.name: south-side house behind the willows (west of S5's house_5800)
entities.what: Small tiled house on the south side of the street, mostly hidden by the willows: its ridge runs east-west along v ~1450 from a curled ornament at its west end to where S5's big roof (house_5800) begins, with a band of round tile-ends below it.
entities.vis: part: mostly behind willow crowns
entities.note: Ridge (double line) v 1450-1465 from the ornament (4975,1420) to ~5145, where S5.bld.house_5800's west hip-gable end begins; tile-ends 4990-5140, v 1465-1500; west of it a lower band 4880-4980, v 1450-1510. Trestle frames stand on the street just above it (4800-5050, v 1340-1440: props). Base est with house_5800's depth (S5: v 1440 -> 1700), the ridge over its middle: the ornament (4975) and the ridge's east end (5145) then fall straight above the middle of its west and east walls.

entities.name: pole scaffold (small 彩楼) on the incense shop's east front
entities.what: A decorated scaffold of tall thin poles with spear-like finials along the incense shop's east front at its south-east corner, on the cross street: the poles rise past the shop's east eave and are tied by a lattice of cross-bars running back along the eave, hung with small ornaments (tassels or goods); a small 彩楼 like the 正店's, the 劉家 signboard standing just north-east of it.
entities.vis: part: the poles' lower parts are hidden behind the lean-to and the shop front; their feet are estimated
entities.note: Poles at u ~2895 (top v ~340), ~2930-2960, ~2985-2990 (top ~260), ~3045 (top ~220), ~3100 (top ~220), ~3117 (top ~260); lattice cross-bars along the east eave from about (2880,560) up to (3110,300). Feet est on the shop's east wall-foot line (S6.bld.incense_shop_liu: (2908,790) -> (3245,440), slope -1.04): at u 2895 v ~803, at u 3117 v ~573, so the scaffold stands along the east front, about 4.5 m of it from the south-east corner. Heights about 6.0 m (west) and 4.1 m (east) on the frame. Added in the merge (lead's second pass): t2 left the poles to the structures agent, which named them in the shop's note as props. Whether they carry goods (a display rack) or are a small 彩楼欢门 is open; built as one structure either way.
